added_failures_note: unmeasured: the reviewed manifest names no base gate log, so the added-failure count was not taken

findings.text: follow-on: the census (imports, patches, source_reads, module_state) is the artefact the move node repoints from, yet the node's gate only asserts each section is present and never re-derives it, so a stale or mis-keyed census would be accepted silently; independent spot-checks (11 from-import names, six patch lines and six source_reads) reconcile with the base tree and module_state is correctly empty because every module-level object is a frozenset or a compiled regex, but no check the worker ran establishes the census against the tree.

follow-on: the census's three categories cover imports and patches and source reads but not prose references to a moved name, and reckon/crew/prompts/review.md:171 cites reckon/crew/promotion.py:_require_review_waiver, which the map places in promotion_checks.py; the reference appears nowhere in the machine-readable census (only the node's free-text follow_ons names it), so a move node reading the census alone would leave the review prompt pointing at a name that will not live there.

follow-on: the map's only falsifiable checks ran inline in the run directory, so the placement, size and edge invariants have no durable guard once the run directory is cleaned; no committed test fails if a member is dropped from a produced module's list and the JSON drifts from promotion.py.

item_verdicts.goal: the node was dispatched to map one module's split (reckon/crew/promotion.py) per section 6 and the section 8 split contract; the two fragment files at docs/evidence/fragments/every-module-fits-a-worker-window/ carry base 0d925378, reckon/crew/promotion.py, seven module entries of path/concern/members/estimated_tokens, the edges and back_references and the four-section census, so the map the goal names exists.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records the gate at EXIT=0 and the drop-one control at EXIT=1 (missing=[_recorded_disposition]), 241 statements, a 25,855-token maximum and zero module-level edges, but leaves baseline_suite/after_suite empty because the map node ran no test arms.

justifications.durability: the placement and size invariants are enforced only by an inline checker in the run directory, so no committed test reddens if the JSON later drifts from promotion.py.
justifications.evidence: the gate log names revision 0d925378 and I re-derived placement (241/241), size (max 25,855) and zero module-level edges from the base tree, but the census is asserted for presence only.
justifications.fit: the produced module names (promotion_evidence, promotion_gate, promotion_scope, promotion_checks, promotion_records, promotion_release) each describe one concern and carry no part number, version or the word core.
justifications.goal_fidelity: docs/evidence/fragments/every-module-fits-a-worker-window/promotion-split-map.json carries the brief's keys (base, module, modules of 7 with concern/members/estimated_tokens, edges, back_references, census, commands) and the HTML table mirrors the JSON row for row.
justifications.reuse: the landed change adds no definition and a capability search over reckon/ and scripts/ found no owner of a module-split map; the only overlap, a revision and byte walk, lives in the node's uncommitted checker and is not in the diff.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff --name-status 0d925378 6f94d788 lists exactly the two declared fragment paths and no file under reckon/, tests/ or scripts/ is touched.
